pages.text: The cauldron supports 25 vanilla effects and thirty-eight custom effects. See Cauldron Brewing for ingredients. This preview uses the effects of a held potion as supplied input; it does not validate a legacy ingredient recipe or grant a potion.

Hold a potion with effects in your main hand and use /brewpreview <redstone> <glowstone> <drink|splash|lingering> [hideParticles]. Counts range from zero to ten; the optional flag defaults to false. Example: /brewpreview 1 1 splash true. Permission level two and a player command source are required. Input potions, ingredients, XP and cauldrons are unchanged.

Potency begins at one, or two with a complete Alchemist set. Glowstone adds potency, capped at two normally or three near a pledged Leonard. Duration multiplier is one plus redstone, capped at three. Final duration is base ticks divided by potency, then multiplied by duration and truncated. Final amplifier increases by potency minus one.

The base bottle allowance is three. Alchemist clothing adds one. When pledged to Leonard, each living Leonard intersecting the 32-block cube around the player adds another bottle allowance and permits potency three. Leonard does not add potency by himself. The preview reads actual gear and nearby entities when run. Cauldron extraction freezes these bonuses at the first bottle.

Brewing uses gunpowder for splash, gunpowder plus Owlet's Wing for lingering, and Raven's Feather to hide particles. Owlet's Wing alone remains drinkable. Potion output carries the original bewitchment_brew marker and calculated color. Exact duplicate effects are removed, magic modifiers go first, and absence/purification/corruption go last in legacy order.

The preview shows each resulting effect's level and tick duration. It preserves the legacy rounding quirk where a one-tick effect can become zero ticks when potency increases. Custom input amplifiers are bounded at 255 to avoid byte overflow. Results are independent copies. This calculator does not prove that an ingredient combination is brewable; unlisted custom-effect ingredients remain unsupported.
